title: Getting Plugged In Beyond Just Showing Up
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges listeners to move beyond just attending church services and to get plugged into a deeper, more meaningful ministry in their lives. By sharing real-life examples and illustrations, Pastor Chris shows why serving and being part of a church family is essential for spiritual growth and flourishing. Listen to discover how to go from just coming to church to truly living out your faith.
